name: Reply to missed calls with Twilio, Google Sheets and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Never lose a job to a missed call

Built for trades and small service businesses: when a customer rings and nobody picks up, this workflow **texts them back within seconds** — from the same number they called — so they don't ring your competitor.

**What it does:**
1. Twilio tells the workflow the outcome of every call
2. Answered calls are ignored; missed ones continue
3. Checks your log — if this caller was already texted in the last 24 hours, it won't text them again (no spamming repeat callers)
4. Sends a different message during opening hours vs. after hours
5. Logs every missed call to Google Sheets
6. Emails the owner so they can ring back

**You will need:** a Twilio number, a Google account, and about 10 minutes. Follow the numbered notes left to right.

## 1. Point Twilio here

Copy the Webhook node's **Production URL** and paste it into Twilio:

Phone Numbers → Manage → your number → **Voice Configuration** → *Call status changes* webhook (HTTP POST).

Twilio posts the outcome of every call. This workflow only reacts to the ones nobody answered.

## 2. Edit these settings

Everything you need to change is in the **CONFIGURE** block at the top of the *Was the call missed?* node:

- your business name
- opening hours and working days
- the two text messages

The *Skip repeat callers* node has one setting: `DEDUPE_HOURS` — how long to wait before texting the same number again (default 24, set to 0 to text every time).

## 3. Connect your accounts

**Twilio** sends the text back. The reply is sent from the same number the customer called, so it comes from a number they recognise.

**Google Sheets** is your missed-call log — select the same spreadsheet in *both* Sheets nodes. Create a sheet with these headers in row 1:

`Time` · `Caller` · `Number called` · `Call status` · `In hours` · `Texted` · `Reply text` · `Call SID`

**Gmail** alerts you. Replace the placeholder address with your own. Optional — delete the node if the sheet is enough.

nodes.name: Was the call missed?
nodes.notes: Filters out answered calls and builds the right reply text for the time of day. All settings live in the CONFIGURE block at the top.

nodes.name: Fetch this caller's history
nodes.notes: Reads your log for earlier entries from the same number, so repeat callers are not texted twice. Select the same spreadsheet as the log node below.

nodes.name: Skip repeat callers
nodes.notes: If this number was already texted within DEDUPE_HOURS, we log the call but do not text again — nobody wants three identical texts for three attempts.

nodes.name: Text the caller back
nodes.notes: Landlines cannot receive SMS. This node is set to continue on error so one undeliverable text never costs you the log entry or the owner alert.

nodes.name: Log the missed call
nodes.notes: Every missed call lands here, whether or not a text went out — the log is also what powers the repeat-caller check.

nodes.name: Alert the owner
nodes.notes: Optional. Replace the placeholder address with your own, or delete this node if the sheet is enough.
